card.name: Inside Japanese personal names
card.fires_on: Partway through Japanese personal names written in English text, on the pieces that spell a given name or surname, such as Hiro, bum, uya or iko. Also fires on the kanji 徹 in a name.

modes.label: Romanized name pieces
modes.description: Middle or ending pieces of Japanese names spelled in Latin letters, in history, manga or news text.

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of Japanese people's names, such as those of manga artists, officials and historical figures.
